build_up_steps.what: White (normal) body armour e.g. 전쟁군주 흉갑 with the normal-armour-only ascendancy node (Masterwork). Ascendancy order: 1st Coal Stoker, 2nd fire-res / damaging-ailment node, 3rd a 'chaos' node, 4th crit-damage-reduction + life. Attack-speed nodes go on the weapon-set tree; weapon set 2 has its own nodes. Any shield with ~1000 armour (enough to T15). Resist 75%+, chaos 40% on day 1 (target 60%+). Ruby rings with fire quality from the act (min 10). Chaos res from rings/belt/boots, two Tacati soul cores. Shield Wall with 4 supports incl. Armour Break and Rapid Attacks. Do not use Svalin. Do not trade until act 4. Craft the shield with essences. End day 1 in white items; don't spend time/money gearing on day 1.

resist 75%+, chaos at least 60% (P1 1:24:14); day 1 chaos 40% is fine (P1 1:25:30)

build_up_steps.when: Right after step 4. Replaces the old Atziri step, which was the price wall.
build_up_steps.what: Cat O' Nine Tails, done as a package: remove the life flask, rebuild the tree toward low life (Int ~80, invest in one line, physical life leech), fix lost resist with a Desert Rune, add Freezing Mark and Execute, drop a support he no longer needs, and add Elemental Weakness (Int 92). Cast it 4-5 times on map entry or after a checkpoint to fall to low life (35%). Cat blocks non-flask recovery at low life, so life stays low. Turn OFF 반발 and turn ON Eternal Rage. He relies on 수호 and Remnants of Kalguur for stability. Cost: Cat ~15 ex (his confirmation of chat). The whole low-budget kit is 10-15 div. The swap itself costs under 1 div; the downside is inconvenience at checkpoints. Shield reaches ~1500 armour by day 3-4.
thresholds_his_statement: replacing Atziri costs less than 1 div (P1 0:24:03-0:24:16)
whole setup ~10-15 div with a high-armour shield (P1 2:27:09)
Elemental Weakness needs Int 92 (P1 2:09:10); tree gives Int ~80 (P1 2:03:30)
